cases.name: native-defaults-and-call-forms
cases.source:
def clean(value=' A '):return value.strip()
def nothing():pass
print(clean(),clean(value=' B '),clean(*[' C ']),clean(**{'value':' D '}),nothing())
clean.__defaults__=(' E ',)
print(clean(),list(map(clean,[' F ',' G '])))
cases.expected:
A B C D None
E ['F', 'G']
cases.stdout:
A B C D None
E ['F', 'G']
